description: Defines the BasketItem entity class representing an item in a shopping basket, including properties for price, quantity, and identifiers, as well as methods to modify quantity with validation.

classes.name: BasketItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a basket item with properties for price, quantity, and associated catalog and basket IDs, including methods to set and add to quantity with validation.

methods.name: BasketItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a BasketItem with catalog item ID, quantity, and unit price.

methods.name: AddQuantity
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity to the current basket item quantity, with validation to ensure non-negative addition.

methods.name: SetQuantity
methods.description: Sets the basket item quantity to a specific value, with validation to ensure non-negative value.
